_about: Extraction-quality ratchet (tests/extraction_quality_bench.rs). 'baseline' = measured before the rule-based typing / table-detection work (commit range M1, 2026-11-06) and is never edited. 'floor' is the ratchet: each milestone that improves a metric raises it; the test fails when a metric drops below its floor (table_false_positives is a ceiling). Tool versions: tesseract 5.5.4, poppler pdftotext 26.11.0.
